dmp.title: RAISE Suite Minimal Technical maDMP MVP v0.2
dmp.description: Minimal maDMP instance for the first RAISE Suite technical MVP. It keeps the RDA maDMP required baseline and adds only the MVP technical fields identified by technical partners under distribution.component_configuration.

dataset.title: RAISE Suite MVP Dataset

distribution.description: Concrete dataset representation/version used for the technical MVP. For the MVP, the identified machine-actionable technical fields are collected under component_configuration.
